name: code_graph
title: Code Graph
description: Code structure and relations from the parsed graph, no text matching. symbols → file outline rows `[export ]kind name (Lstart-end) signature`; find_symbol returns declaration/body; references adds usages; callers/callees return locations; dependents/impact → importers and blast radius. Exact identifiers: find_symbol/references/callers/callees; keywords: symbol_search/search; literal text and regex belong to grep. Prefer it over read/grep for declarations and relations. symbols already outlines a file: never pair it with overview for one need.

mode.description: Use files for imports, dependents, related, impact and symbols, or for a scoped overview (omit files for project overview). Use symbols for find_symbol, symbol_search/search, references, callers and callees.

files.description: Project-relative or absolute paths. Optional file scope for symbol queries; callers uses files to select declarations, not to restrict where callers can be found.

symbols.description: Exact identifiers or search keywords, depending on mode. In symbols mode these optionally filter the outline. When a symbol query also names files, it runs each symbol against each file; distinct pairs need separate calls.

body.description: true for implementation, false for locations; find_symbol defaults true, references is opt-in.

limit.description: Max rows per result in symbols, find_symbol, symbol_search/search, references, and callers. Modes may cap lower; for transitive callers this is the page size.

depth.description: Single-file overview outline depth or caller traversal depth (callers depth 2–5 is transitive); default 1.

page.description: Page of transitive callers only (mode callers, depth 2–5); default 1. Keep the other arguments, including limit, unchanged when continuing.

node_offset.description: Recover an oversized transitive caller entry in UTF-8 byte chunks. Use one symbol, at most one file, limit:1 and the entry's page. Start at 0 and use the returned next offset.

cwd.description: Explicit root outside the project; omit for project root.
